name: What can go wrong when framing a door opening?

mainEntity.name: What can go wrong when framing a door opening?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest risk is undersizing the rough opening or building the header incorrectly, which can lead to a door that won’t hang square or a wall that isn’t properly supported. You also want to avoid framing before confirming the door specs, because even small measurement errors can cause delays and rework.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common problems are a wrong rough opening, poor support framing, and doors that don’t fit or close properly.
